# Business Description
Description: Shivam Tours & Travels is a professional taxi and car rental service based in Trichy, Tamil Nadu, India. The company provides 24/7 local taxi services, outstation cabs, airport pickup and drop, one-way taxi services, car rentals with driver, tempo traveller rentals, and wedding car rentals across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Puducherry.
